issue: Install: Expose Waypoint Resources [closed; labels kind/enhancement, area/ambient]
**Describe the feature request**

Provide the ability to customize waypoint deployment resources at install through Helm values. This approach provides consistency with other components that expose configurable resources.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
1. Using gatewayclass or gateway annotations to configure waypoint resources, e.g. `networking.istio.io/waypoint-cpu-requests: 500m`. This approach provides consistency in customizing an ingress gateway but will be superseded in the future by …

following option.
2. With https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/pull/2924, gateway `parametersRef` can manage waypoint resources. However, this requires considerable API changes to implement.
